newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat ends mixed after hitting contract lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat ends mixed after hitting contract lows.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended mixed with old crop futures down, while new crop rose. But old and new crop futures had seen contract lows during a volatile day's trading.
"The old crop's in its death throes," one trader said, noting that it remained under supply pressure.
New crop was helped up by sterling's small fall. But volatility on foreign exchange markets was putting market players off, the trader said.
"Currency's more of a hindrance," he said.
November was the most active contract month, with 529 of a total 1,021 lots done. It last traded 0.85 stg lower, at 93.25.
Earlier in the day November equalled its contract low of 91.75 stg, last seen on January 22.
July dominated old crop trade, with 265 lots done. It last traded 0.50 stg lower at 88.50 stg, having bounced off an all-time contract low of 87.00 stg.
On barley, only the new crop was traded. November, the most active month with 70 of a total 95 lots traded, last changed hands 0.25 stg higher at 90.25 stg.
